recipes.name: Ironman Breakfast
steps: Combine oats and water in a very deep microwaveable bowl.
Microwave for 3-5 minutes, depending on your microwave wattage.
(Alternatively, oats can be cooked on the stove).
Remove oatmeal from microwave (careful, it's hot!) and stir in remaining ingredients.
Can be made with more raisins, really it's up to your own raisin tolerance :).
Sometimes I add slivered almonds or walnuts, depending on my mood and their availability.

recipes.name: Two Tin Lunch
steps: Mix the tuna, corn and mayonnaise together.
Season to taste.
Serve on crispbreads.
Garnish with parsley if desired.

recipes.name: Tuna Dinner
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 ounce) can of cream of mushroom soup
steps: Drain oil/water from tuna.
In a saucepan, saute green pepper & onions.
Blend in soup.
Add milk & beat.
Place rice in greased 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.
Arrange tuna over rice & pour saucee on top.
Bake at 350F for 25 minute.

recipes.name: Clipper Ship Casserole
ingredients: 6 ounces of shredded sharp cheddar cheese
steps: In skillet, cook onion, celery and green pepper in oil until tender.
Stir in tomato sauce, mayo, tuna and seasonings; simmer 5 minutes.
In a 2 quart casserole, layer half the macaroni, half the tuna, half the cheese and.
half the corn chips.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 350* for 30 minute  Serves 6.

recipes.name: White Chocolate Mocha Supreme
ingredients: 2 cups of hot fresh brewed coffee or 2 cups espresso
steps: In a microwave-safe bowl, add chocolate morsels and half-n-half.
Cook on HIGH for 2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute.
Stir until chocolate is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add hot coffee; mix until blended.
Ladle into coffee mugs.
Top with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Candy Cups
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups of hershey's premier white chocolate chips
steps: Place chip and nut mixture in medium microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave at MEDIUM (50%) 30 seconds; stir.
If necessary, microwave at MEDIUM an additional 15 seconds at a time, stirring after each heating, until chips are melted and mixture is blended when stirred.
Drop by rounded teaspoons into small paper candy cups.
(Mixture may also be dropped onto wax paper-lined cookie sheet.) Cool until set.
Store in cool, dry place.
About 1 dozen candies.

recipes.name: Nutella Stix-N-Stones
steps: Line 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil.
(I believe 1 sheet is for toasting the nuts& the second sheet is for the candy.) In a bowl, melt the white chocolate chips& PB chips in microwave on medium power for 2 minutes.
(Also can be melted in a double boiler) Add Nutella& stir until smooth to the melted chips.
Gently fold in nuts& noodles until completely combined.
Drop by heaping tablespoons onto prepared sheet and allow to set for 30 minutes.
Store in airtight container.
-----Totoast hazelnuts----.
Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Spread hazelnuts on baking sheet& toast until lightly brown, about 10-15 minutes.
Allow nuts to cool completely before handling.
If using hazelnuts with skin on, rub them together in kitchen towel after cooling to remove skins.

recipes.name: Banana Ghouls
steps: Cut the bananas in half crosswise.
Insert a pop cycle stick about 2 inches into cut end of one half.
Repeat with remaining halves.
Place on waxed paper and freeze for about one hour.
Microwave white-chocolate chips on high for about 2 minutes, or until completely melted.
Spoon over bananas covering them completely.
While chocolate is still soft, press in 2 Fruit Loops for eyes and 1 for the mouth.
Freeze banana again until chocolate is hard.
